info.headline: Notify NYC - Planned Natural Gas Work - 10/7 - 34th Avenue (QN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-06-2026 at 03:13 PM.
National Grid is scheduled to conduct natural gas work near 34th Avenue between 111th Street and 112th Street in Queens. The work is scheduled to take place between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM on 10/7. Please report natural gas emergencies to 9-1-1 if they occur.
To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2r7rfxe.
